common_order: start_segment only if accepted and unrestricted
clear end/driving only if failed and alive

prepare.failure: set selector and directions[0] to terminal; set_speed_zero, including owner removed
prepare.direction_queue: shift unless shared skip-shift entry; terminal kept for shared entry

continuation.pre_admission: commit template; invalidate; driving=1; refresh; driving=0; alive/flag76/flag7A guards; invalidate
continuation.candidate: after refresh; accept/start callbacks read live context
continuation.failure: keep existing sampling close-out; do not use Prepare fallback
